transcript: Speaker 1: SSM Repak support, Isabel speaking. How can I help?
Speaker 2: Hi, I just have a quick general question. Are your support lines open at the weekend?
Speaker 1: Of course. Can I take your name or account reference first?
Speaker 2: I'd rather not give details, it's really just a general question.

Speaker 2: And is the email support address the same as on the website?
